text_to_image_prompt:
Feminine confident athletic sculptor. Warm medium olive-tan skin, dark chocolate hair swept back with loose texture into long low ponytail, amber hazel eyes, strong softly rectangular face, broad elegant nose, naturally full lips. Clean cream crewneck athletic top with warm gray open overshirt, tiny gold stud earrings. Distinct warm-toned identity; maintain stylized 3D, not real photography.

Create one fictional adult in premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D CG rendering, detailed individually resolved hair strands, natural delicate skin texture and crisp clothing and ornament materials. A landscape 1536x1024, 3:2 close-up head-and-upper-shoulders turnaround sheet. Three equal-width views in one horizontal row: LEFT true straight-on FRONT view with direct gaze, CENTER exact 90-degree PROFILE facing image-left, RIGHT exact 180-degree BACK view with no face visible. Same identity, hairstyle, clothing and accessory locations across all views. Camera at eye height, level upright head, neutral closed lips, matching head scale and crown levels, complete crown in frame. Pure opaque white background, soft even neutral studio lighting, natural cranial proportions. No text, labels, borders, watermarks, extra people, hands or full body.
Front view: low ponytail is centered behind the head and neck, with only a very narrow amount visible from the front. Side and rear show the coherent low ponytail.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit. Produce ONE final three-view portrait sheet at EXACTLY 1536x1024 pixels, 3:2 landscape. Input 1 is the ORIGINAL HIGH-DETAIL MASTER and primary edit target, authoritative for identity, facial geometry, colors, hair strand definition, sharpness, skin texture, clothing and ornament detail. Input 2, if supplied, is ONLY a placement guide for the previously corrected hair; do not copy its softened or degraded texture. Reconstruct directly from ORIGINAL MASTER, not by re-editing the softer guide. Match or exceed the crisp fine detail of input 1: individually resolved fine hairs, clean eyelashes and iris texture, natural skin microtexture, sharp embroidery/knit and jewelry edges, no blur, no waxy smoothing, no painterly smearing, no low-resolution upsampling, no sharpening halos or oversaturated contrast. Maintain same original semi-realistic 3D CG look. Keep the original three equal panels, left straight front, center exact left-facing side profile, right exact back, level camera, identical crop/head scale and white background. Preserve all facial identities, proportions, expressions and outfits. No text or watermarks. LEFT FRONT PANEL: reduce excessive rear ponytail masses beside the jaw and neck. ONE low ponytail sits at CENTER NAPE and descends down CENTER BACK, mostly occluded by the head/neck/torso in frontal view; only tiny narrow slivers visible beside lower neck, no wide lateral wings or side ponytail. Input 2 shows correct narrow frontal silhouette. Preserve exact original face and eyes, forehead hair and fine facial wisps. Restore ORIGINAL-master fine detail in face, hair and clothing. Keep CENTER PROFILE and RIGHT REAR exactly like input 1.
